:::{#exm-model-family}
#### Polynomials of degree at most $\polydeg$

The polynomials of degree at most $\polydeg$ form a [mean-function model family](#def-model-family) $\modelfam$:
each polynomial maps a [covariate](#def-covariate) value $\predvar$ to a candidate for the value of the [mean function](#def-mean-function) at $\predvar$,
and the members differ in their coefficients.

:::
